messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>; Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:08:00Z
Subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping — Acme Health

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to kick off the security review so we can keep the procurement timeline moving: 

- Objective: Get alignment on scope and intake for the security questionnaire so Redwood can prepare evidence and a tailored review package.
- Stakeholders noted on the call:
  - Alex Johnson — sponsor / product lead (economic buyer)
  - Priya Shah — security lead (controls & POA)
  - Tom Lee — procurement (contracts & SOW)
  - Nate Carter — IT / SRE (network & infra details)

Attachments: I’ve attached our standard security questionnaire (redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf) and a first-pass SOW doc (acme_sow_draft_v1.docx) for Tom to review.

Ask / next steps (proposed):
1) Priya: confirm systems in-scope for the review (see questions below) and any compliance frameworks you want us to prioritize (e.g., HITRUST/SOC2).
2) Tom: confirm procurement steps and whether you need a redlined MSA or PO prior to evidence exchange.
3) Nate / IT: confirm whether the service will be used behind your VPC or via hosted API (affects evidence we provide).
4) Redwood action: we’ll complete the intake questionnaire and start pulling evidence once we have the confirmed scope (~3–5 business days).

Quick intake questions for Priya/Nate to answer in-line:
- Systems in scope: Is this for Production only, or dev/staging as well?
- Data types: Will any PHI (protected health information) be sent to Redwood?
- Network: Will you require Private deployment (VPC) or are hosted API calls acceptable?

Feel free to reply-all with brief answers and we’ll lock a 30-min kickoff if helpful.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
https://www.redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (pdf, 48 pages)
Attachment: acme_sow_draft_v1.docx (docx, 8 pages)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Nate Carter <nate.carter@acmehealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T18:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping — Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

On scope:
- Systems in scope: Production and Staging only. We do NOT want dev included at this stage.
- Data types: Primary traffic will be de-identified patient summaries and metadata. We do plan one pilot with limited PHI (consented) — will need to scope that separately.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is the immediate ask; long-term we may pursue HITRUST but not required for initial procurement.

Network / deployment:
- Prefer Hosted API for the pilot due to time constraints, but we will need to evaluate the Private/VPC option if PHI pilot expands.
- For hosted API: require encryption in transit & at rest, key rotation policy, and data retention settings (we expect deletion after 30 days unless otherwise retained).

Evidence & questionnaire:
- We can share a completed controls mapping if you provide a SOC2/control matrix template.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide architecture diagrams and pen test reports as part of the initial evidence pack?

Finally, small ask for the kickoff: can we add our legal contact (Tom Lee) to the SOW thread so procurement can track milestones and payment terms?

—Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Security, Acme Health

Marissa / team —

Thanks. Quick notes from procurement: 
- We typically require a signed MSA + SOW before providing any sensitive or production-level data for security validation. A redline is fine; please send an editable MSA if you have one.
- Payment terms: standard Net-45. If Redwood requires different terms for Dedicated capacity, let me know and we can route for approval.
- We also need a data processing addendum (DPA) that covers PHI handling. Please include a DPA draft with the SOW.

I’ll review the SOW you attached and send redlines by end of day tomorrow. In the meantime, please keep any evidence shared to a secure link (we will provide access details once MSA is in place).

Tom Lee
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Health

Appreciate the quick replies — great alignment. Summary of agreed actions and owners: 

1) Scope confirmed: Production + Staging only (Priya) — Redwood will not ingest dev data.
2) Deployment: Hosted API for pilot (Priya/Nate) — Redwood will prepare documentation on encryption, key rotation, and retention. (Owner: Rishi)
3) Evidence: Redwood to assemble SOC2 control matrix, architecture diagrams, and latest pen test report. Target to deliver initial evidence pack in 3–5 business days after SOW/MSA baseline agreed. (Owner: Dev)
4) Contracts & DPA: Marissa to share editable MSA + DPA and updated SOW. Tom to redline and return. (Owner: Marissa / Tom)
5) PHI pilot: Priya to outline boundaries for the limited PHI pilot; we’ll treat PHI as out-of-scope until DPA is signed.

Next meeting: propose a 30-min kickoff on Tue 2026-07-15 at 11:00 AM ET to review scope and timeline — please reply with availability.

Docs I’ll attach in follow-up: editable MSA (docx), DPA template (pdf), SOC2 control matrix template (xlsx).

Thanks —
